exposure: maternal pesticide and chemical exposure during pregnancy
cohort: 100 children aged 0-16 years (50 cases and 50 controls) in Sulaimani Hiwa Hospital and Pediatric Teaching Hospital from 1st January to 1st May 2018
finding: Risk factors linked to cancer were cesarean section, family history, mothers exposed to pesticides and chemicals during pregnancy, children exposed to pesticide, exposed to passive smoke, children’s caffeine consumption and fast food.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was linked to cancer (odds 2.7, P=0.02).
